title: Caller corrects business type mid-call
persona: Omar Haddad, small business owner in Dearborn, friendly, a bit scattered, self-corrects out loud.
goal: Book the setup call after fixing that he runs an electrical business, not plumbing.
opening_line: Hi, I run a plumbing company and I want help with my phones.

turns.caller: Sorry, no, I said that wrong. It's electrical. We do electrical work.
Yeah, residential mostly. Some small commercial.
We miss a lot of calls when we're up on jobs.
Oh and it's three guys, not five. I said five before. Sorry.
So how would it answer for an electrician?
Okay, book the call. Friday works.

branches.if_agent: asks for his name again after he gave it
branches.caller: I'm Omar Haddad, I told you already.

curveballs: Corrects trade from plumbing to electrical
Corrects crew size from five to three
expected: Switches to electrician framing with no further plumbing references
Uses three, not five, if crew size comes up
Explains how AVA would answer an electrician's calls
Quotes $497 a month plus $497 one-time setup
Books the 15-minute setup call without re-asking details he gave
must_not: Keep referring to plumbing after the correction
